title: QB1_G#q32 shipped a truncated Merchant Shipping Notice citation; verified against the DGMA source as MS Notice 1 of 2026
candidate_claim: Raised as OPEN-G1-006 while adjudicating AUG-0049 (Empanelment of salvors), reported by an August 2026 candidate.
rationale: The candidate-facing question text read 'Empanelment of salvors. ( ms notice 1 of 202)'. 202 is not a year. The truncation mattered more than a typo would, because the card body never states the notice number anywhere: it refers only to 'the relevant Director General of Shipping (DGS) Merchant Shipping Notice' and to 'specialized MS Notices'. The truncated string in the stem was therefore the only citation a candidate could take away, and it was unusable. The open item required the number to be verified against the DGMA source rather than reconstructed from the truncation, and it was: the Directorate General of Maritime Administration's own Nautical Wing casualty page records MS Notice No. 01 of 2026, dated 15 January 2026, prescribing the checklist for empanelment and retention of salvors under Section 255 of the Merchant Shipping Act 2025, with applications commencing 01 March 2026. The notice published on the same official domain carries 'Merchant Shipping Notice No. 01 of 2026' in its own title. The missing digit is 6, read from the source. 'ms notice' was also normalised to 'MS Notice', which is how the rest of the bank writes it.
note: This correction changes candidate-facing QUESTION TEXT, which is unusual and has a wider surface than a body edit: the same string is emitted into the page's JSON-LD Question name, into the QB1_FG cheat sheet cue, and into the generated examiner index, which carries it twice (the Simon and Rajappan rows for QB1_G#q32). All generated surfaces are regenerated from the live corpus rather than hand-edited. The historical evidence ledgers are NOT rewritten: EXAMINER_EVIDENCE_LEDGER.jsonl records source_wording, which is what the source sheet actually said and remains true of that source. Only claims ABOUT the live text are refreshed, and only by their generators.
